Dental fistula, with persistent bloody, salty

sections.text:
Heaviness and weight in stomach. Heat
in stomach before meals. Sour eructations. Averse to
cotfee, wants fancy dishes. Stomach symptoms relieved
by tight clothes. Desire for highly seasoned food.

sections.text:
Soreness over liver. Flatus and eructa-
tions.

sections.text: Bilious diarrhoea, with aversion to coffee.

sections.text:
Burning in urethra. Sexual passion and de-

Scanty, dark. In dropsy, produces frequent

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menses copious, frequent, too long. Ul-
ceration of uterus and os. Copious and excoriating leu-
corrhoea. Nymphomania.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Oppression of chest, difficult breathing,
great dyspnoea. Hydrothorax.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Inflammation of joints of fingers.
Feeling as of a splinter under nail. Nails crumble.
Caries and necrosis, especially of long bones.
